stemMd: A cube has side length 4. What is the length of a diagonal joining opposite vertices through its interior?
explanationMd: Apply Pythagoras in three perpendicular directions: diagonal squared=4 squared+4 squared+4 squared=48. Its positive square root is 4 times the square root of 3.

distractorRationale.b: This doubles the side without using three-dimensional geometry.
distractorRationale.d: This adds three side lengths instead of combining perpendicular components.
distractorRationale.c: This is a face area, not a length.
